result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards render correctly. The horizontally clipped carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected behaviors and not counted. One visual defect stands out: the bottom navigation bar's active-tab indicator (a dark horizontal bar) is misplaced, overlapping the search and bookmark icons instead of sitting under the active tab, and the bottom nav icons lack labels.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a dark horizontal pill/bar (likely a selected-tab indicator or home-indicator overlay) is drawn across the middle of the bar, overlapping the search icon and the bookmark/orders icon instead of being positioned beneath the active tab or at the screen's bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the indicator so it does not intersect nav icons: place it under the active tab item or move the gesture/home indicator below the icon row with adequate spacing.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders/bookmark, profile) have no text labels, relying on iconography alone, which can hurt discoverability and screen-reader clarity if labels are missing entirely.
issues.suggestion: Add small text labels under each icon (or ensure accessible names are set) so each tab's purpose is clear.

issues.description: The notification bell button in the top-right shows a red dot badge, but the bell icon itself is low-contrast dark-on-light gray circle; combined with the subtle badge it may be missed, and the badge has no count.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the badge is clearly visible and consider showing a count or stronger contrast for the bell icon within its circular container.
